items.description: Client must give Host Owner access to the Subaccount(s) so Host can monitor performance and set up auto-withdrawals as agreed in the Service Order.
items.span_text: Client will provide Host with Owner access to the Subaccount(s) to enable Host to monitor performance of the Colocation Servers, Profit Share percentages, and set up auto-withdrawals of BTC Revenue as agreed upon in the Service Order.

items.description: Host must invoice Client for the previous Billing Period within five Business Days after that period ends, with the reconciliation statement and supporting documents.
items.span_text: Host shall issue the invoice of Cost of Revenue, Operations Service Fee, Power Prepayment, credit for Curtailment Program Revenue and any other fees or adjustments for the previous Billing Period to Client within five (5) Business Days from the end of such Billing Period

items.description: Client may object to an invoice by written notice to Host within seven days after receiving it.
items.span_text: Client shall be entitled to raise to Host any objection to an invoice (including its attachments) issued by Host in accordance with this Article by written notice to Host within seven (7) days upon receipt of such invoice.

items.description: Undisputed amounts and pass-through costs must be paid in full even if an objection or dispute is raised.
items.span_text: Any undisputed amounts, or pass through costs (including without limitation, Power Reimbursement), must be paid in full despite any objection or disputes.

items.description: Invoices are payable ten days after the date they are issued.
items.span_text: Invoices are due ten (10) days from the date of issue.

items.anchor_event: date of issue of the invoice
items.description: Host must remit any remaining credit to Client within fifteen days of the invoice issue date.
items.span_text: If there is a credit outstanding to Client after these deductions are made, then Host will remit a credit to Client within fifteen (15) days of the date of issue of the invoice.
items.trigger: If there is a credit outstanding to Client after these deductions are made

items.description: Late sums owed by Client accrue interest at the lower of the stated monthly rate or the legal maximum, from the original due date until paid.
items.span_text: All sums due and payable by Client which are not timely paid in accordance with Paragraph 3, shall be subject to interest at 1.5% per month or the maximum amount permitted by law (whichever is lower), computed from the original due date until paid.
items.trigger: which are not timely paid in accordance with Paragraph 3

items.description: Client must pay Host's attorney's fees, costs and expenses incurred to compel payment or enforce Host's rights.
items.span_text: In the event that an attorney be employed or expenses be incurred to compel payment for any sums due the Host under this Agreement or to enforce any rights or remedies of Host in accordance therewith, Client shall pay all such attorney’s fees, costs, and expenses incurred by Host
items.trigger: In the event that an attorney be employed or expenses be incurred to compel payment for any sums due the Host under this Agreement or to enforce any rights or remedies of Host in accordance therewith

items.anchor_event: due date of each of Client’s payments
items.description: Host must issue a Confirmation of Colocation Servers' Security within five Business Days before each Client payment due date, failing which Client may postpone payments.
items.span_text: Host shall issue a Confirmation of Colocation Servers’ Security (in the form as attached in APPENDIX III hereto) of providing Colocation Servers’ latest information and the current business operation of Host within not more than five (5) Business Days before the due date of each of Client’s payments hereunder

items.description: Operations Service Fee payments, remittances and refunds must follow the payment method in the applicable Service Order.
items.span_text: All payment of Operations Service Fees pursuant to this Agreement, including any remittance or refund of Operations Service Fees, shall be made in accordance with paragraph 3.1 of the applicable Service Order.

items.description: Host may suspend Services if an amount due has not been paid when due.
items.span_text: Host may suspend the provision of Services under this Agreement if any amount due and payable under this Agreement has not been paid when due and payable
items.trigger: if any amount due and payable under this Agreement has not been paid when due and payable

items.description: Before suspending Services, Host must give Client written notice and an opportunity to cure at least five days ahead.
items.span_text: prior to any such suspension Host will provide Client with written notice of suspension and an opportunity to cure at least five days prior to any such suspension

items.description: Host must reinstate suspended Services within three Business Days after outstanding fees are paid in cleared funds.
items.span_text: Host must within three (3) Business Days reinstate the Services once all outstanding fees have been paid in cleared funds.
items.trigger: once all outstanding fees have been paid in cleared funds

items.description: Host may terminate the Agreement if a suspension lasts longer than the stated period.
items.span_text: If a suspension lasts longer than 30 days, the Host may terminate this Agreement.
items.trigger: If a suspension lasts longer than 30 days

items.description: Host may pass through increased fees, taxes, levies and similar costs to Client in proportion to Client's Profit Share percentage where applicable.
items.span_text: Host shall have the right to pass through any such amounts to Client proportionally based on the Client’s Profit Share percentage where applicable.

items.description: Either party may set off amounts it owes the other against amounts the other owes it under this Agreement.
items.span_text: Each Party may set-off and deduct any amounts payable under this Agreement to the other Party against any amounts owing by the other Party to the first Party pursuant to this Agreement

items.description: Client must put unique identifiers on all assets before delivery.
items.span_text: Client must affix unique identifiers to all assets prior to delivery.

items.description: Client must use the Colocation Servers at the facility only for cryptocurrency mining.
items.span_text: Client must use the Colocation Servers at the Data Center Facility solely for cryptocurrency mining operations.

items.description: Client must obtain and comply with all licenses needed for software and firmware on the Colocation Servers.
items.span_text: Client must secure and comply with all licenses as are required to operate any software and firmware installed by or accessed on the Colocation Servers.
